items.label: Supportive Back & Wide Armrests
items.value: Designed for ergonomic relaxation, this loveseat bean bag chair features a tall, backrest and extra-wide armrests that provide ample support for your back, shoulders, and arms. Whether you're sitting upright or reclining, every angle is made for comfort

items.label: Premium Faux Fur
items.value: Wrapped in high-quality, heavy-craft faux fur, this sofa couch in a box feels ultra-soft and warm against the skin. The plush texture brings elegance and comfort to any room, whether modern, minimalist, or cozy

items.label: Elastic Comfort Support
items.value: This boneless sofa is filled with high-density foam and shredded foam, combining elastic support structure and soft comfort. Two pillows can provide additional waist or neck support, giving you a fully customizable leisure experience

items.label: Seamlessly Blends Into Your Life
items.value: Perfect for living rooms, bedrooms, dorms, reading corners, or even creative studio spaces. This bean bag loveseat sofa effortlessly with a wide range of interior styles, offering both function and aesthetic value for modern homes

items.label: No Assembly Required
items.value: The bean bag chair in a box requires zero setup. Just unpack it, place it in a ventilated and dry environment, allow 48 hours for full rebound, and enjoy plush comfort without the hassle of tools or instructions
